name: session-reel
description: Turn a Claude Code session into shareable MP4 replays, 16:9 and 9:16: /reel

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: desktop and desktop-light look like the Claude Code desktop app; paper is warm with serif replies; terminal looks like the CLI.

format.title: Format
format.description: both renders a 16:9 (YouTube, X) and a 9:16 (Shorts, Reels, TikTok) video each time.

length.title: Length (seconds)
length.description: Target video length, 10 to 600. Short sessions come out shorter.

sound.title: Sound
sound.description: Typing under each prompt, the Enter key on send, a page flick over long breaks and one knock on the final count. Off by default; on adds them.

text.title: Text size
text.description: large makes every line 15% bigger, for phone screens.

camera.title: Camera moves
camera.description: on opens close on the first prompt and pushes in while you type; off keeps the frame still.

accent.title: Accent colour
accent.description: A hex colour like #D97757 for the prompt mark and highlights. Empty uses the theme's.

watermark.title: Watermark
watermark.description: A small "made with session-reel" line on the closing card.

fps.title: Frame rate
fps.description: 60 is smoother; 30 renders faster and makes smaller files.
